paper_style_reference.reason: The repository contains PIA-style Top-K/semantic/calibration code paths, but no frozen, audited paper-style Skytrax-150 holdout reference configuration is pre-registered here.

primary_hypothesis: H1: B0-SPARSE improves Token Accuracy over B0 on Skytrax-150 holdout, layer17, seeds 42/43/44.

secondary_hypotheses.H4: B0-SPARSE remains positive over B0 on layer11 and layer19.

success_criteria.attention: B0-LAER must exceed both B0-SPARSE and B0-SHUFFLED-LAER with positive statistical evidence before claiming true server attention adds reconstruction benefit.
success_criteria.primary: B0-SPARSE minus B0 Token Accuracy mean delta > 0 and prompt-cluster bootstrap 95% CI lower bound > 0.
